Missing SparkR package does not fail immediately
Issue Type: Improvement
Assignee: Unassigned
Created: 29/Mar/15 4:53 PM
Priority: Minor
Reporter: Felix Cheung

Is there a reason why sparkR and sparkR-submit are both loading SparkR with require()?

sparkR https://github.com/amplab-extras/SparkR-pkg/blob/c10148e07525e7d3b5c5b2be1b2b8c45a6c495fd/sparkR

sparkR-submit https://github.com/amplab-extras/SparkR-pkg/blob/c10148e07525e7d3b5c5b2be1b2b8c45a6c495fd/pkg/inst/sparkR-submit

From this http://yihui.name/en/2014/07/library-vs-require/
and this http://stackoverflow.com/questions/5595512/what-is-the-difference-between-require-and-library,

it seems it should either get a boolean return value and check for it, or simply use library(SparkR) instead.

Thought? I check and this is the same in the shell.R with SparkR/Spark 1.4.0.
